#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <stdexcept>

class HopcroftKarpBipartiteMatching {
public:
    const int m, n;
    const std::vector<std::vector<int>>& g;
    std::vector<int> pairU, pairV, dis;
    const int inf = 10000000;
    const int NIL = 0;

    HopcroftKarpBipartiteMatching(int m, int n, const std::vector<std::vector<int>>& g)
        : m(m), n(n), g(g), pairU(m + 1, NIL), pairV(n + 1, NIL), dis(m + 1) {}

    int maximumMatching() {
        std::fill(pairU.begin(), pairU.end(), NIL);
        std::fill(pairV.begin(), pairV.end(), NIL);
        int maxMatching = 0;

        while (bfs()) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
                if (pairU[i] == NIL && dfs(i)) {
                    maxMatching++;
                }
            }
        }
        return maxMatching;
    }

    bool bfs() {
        std::queue<int> q;
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            if (pairU[i] == NIL) {
                q.push(i);
                dis[i] = 0;
            } else {
                dis[i] = inf;
            }
        }
        dis[NIL] = inf;

        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front();
            q.pop();
            if (dis[u] < dis[NIL]) {
                for (int v : g[u]) {
                    if (dis[pairV[v]] == inf) {
                        q.push(pairV[v]);
                        dis[pairV[v]] = dis[u] + 2;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dis[NIL] < inf;
    }

    bool dfs(int u) {
        if (u != NIL) {
            for (int v : g[u]) {
                if (dis[pairV[v]] == dis[u] + 2) {
                    if (dfs(pairV[v])) {
                        pairV[v] = u;
                        pairU[u] = v;
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
            dis[u] = inf;
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
};

class InputReader {
private:
    std::istream& stream;

public:
    InputReader(std::istream& stream) : stream(stream) {}

    int nextInt() {
        int c, sgn = 1, res = 0;
        while ((c = stream.peek()) != EOF && (c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t')) {
            stream.ignore();
        }
        if (c == '-') {
            sgn = -1;
            stream.ignore();
        }
        while ((c = stream.peek()) != EOF && c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
            stream.ignore();
        }
        return res * sgn;
    }
};

class OutputWriter {
private:
    std::ostream& writer;

public:
    OutputWriter(std::ostream& outputStream) : writer(outputStream) {}

    void println(long long i) {
        writer << i << "\n";
    }
};

class _1047D {
public:
    int n, m;

    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, OutputWriter& out) {
        n = in.nextInt();
        m = in.nextInt();

        long long ans = 0;

        if (n > 100) {
            int nn = (n - 100) % 6;
            long long nq = (n - 100) / 6;
            ans += nq * 6LL * m;
            n = 100 + nn;
        }

        if (m > 100) {
            int nm = (m - 100) % 6;
            long long mq = (m - 100) / 6;
            ans += mq * 6LL * n;
            m = 100 + nm;
        }

        std::vector<std::vector<int>> mat(n + 1, std::vector<int>(m + 1, 0));
        int u = 1, v = 1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                if ((i + j) % 2 == 0) mat[i][j] = u++;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                if ((i + j) % 2 != 0) mat[i][j] = v++;
            }
        }

        std::vector<std::vector<int>> g(u);
        for (int i = 0; i < u; i++) g[i] = std::vector<int>();

        int dx[] = {-3, -2, -2, 0, -1, 1, 0, -1, 1, 3, 2, 2};
        int dy[] = {0, -1, 1, -3, -2, -2, 3, 2, 2, 0, -1, 1};

        for (int x = 1; x <= n; x++) {
            for (int y = 1; y <= m; y++) {
                if ((x + y) % 2 == 0) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < 12; k++) {
                        int nx = x + dx[k], ny = y + dy[k];
                        if (nx >= 1 && ny >= 1 && nx <= n && ny <= m) {
                            g[mat[x][y]].push_back(mat[nx][ny]);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        HopcroftKarpBipartiteMatching bpm(u - 1, v - 1, g);
        ans += 2LL * bpm.maximumMatching();
        out.println(ans);
    }
};

int main() {
    InputReader in(std::cin);
    OutputWriter out(std::cout);
    _1047D solver;
    solver.solve(1, in, out);
    return 0;
}
